dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Absent as distinct horizontal bands; replaced by high-contrast, thin white fringes on the tips of the greater and median coverts creating a scalloped effect.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent with sharp boundaries; thin pale edges contrast sharply against the dark-brown bodies of the folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Visible as a distinct transition from the relatively uniform brownish-grey plumage of the nape to the heavily scaled texture of the upper mantle.
